# Code of Conduct

This code of conduct is adapted from the Contributor Covenant.
It sets out the standards we expect from everyone taking part
in this project.

## Our pledge

We want participation in this project to be a positive experience for everyone,
regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex
characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education,
socioeconomic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or
sexual identity and orientation.

We pledge to act and interact in ways that keep the community open, welcoming,
diverse, inclusive, and healthy.

## Our standards

Behavior that helps build a positive environment includes:

- showing empathy and kindness toward others;
- respecting differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences;
- giving and accepting constructive feedback gracefully;
- taking responsibility for our mistakes, apologizing to those affected, and
  learning from the experience;
- focusing on what is best for the community as a whole, not just for ourselves.

Behavior that is not acceptable includes:

- unwelcome personal or romantic attention of any kind;
- insults, demeaning remarks, or personal and political attacks;
- harassment, whether in public or in private;
- publishing someone else's private information, such as a physical or email
  address, without their explicit permission;
- any other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a
  professional setting.

## Our responsibilities

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing these standards.
They may take fair and appropriate corrective action in response to any behavior
they consider inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.

Maintainers have the right and responsibility to remove, edit, or reject
comments, commits, code, issues, and other contributions that do not align with
this code of conduct, and will explain their decisions when appropriate.

## Scope

This code of conduct applies in all project spaces, and also applies when an
individual is officially representing the project in public spaces. Examples
include using an official project email address, posting through an official
account, or acting as an appointed representative at an event.

## Enforcement

Instances of unacceptable behavior may be reported to the project maintainer at
**obooklage@gmail.com**. All complaints will be reviewed and investigated promptly
and fairly.

Maintainers are obligated to respect the privacy and security of anyone who
reports an incident.

### Enforcement guidelines

Maintainers will follow these guidelines when deciding on the consequences of
any action they judge to be in breach of this code of conduct:

1. **Correction.** For inappropriate language or other behavior considered
   unprofessional, a private, written warning, with an explanation of why the
   behavior was inappropriate. A public apology may be requested.
2. **Warning.** For a single incident or a series of incidents, a warning with
   consequences for continued behavior. This may include a temporary limit on
   interaction with the people involved.
3. **Temporary ban.** For a serious breach of standards, a temporary ban from
   any interaction with the community for a specified period.
4. **Permanent ban.** For a pattern of repeated breaches or sustained
   inappropriate behavior, a permanent ban from any interaction within the
   community.

## Attribution

This code of conduct is adapted from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1,
available at
https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html, with the
